title.en: Electric Low Pressure 60 Carries the Label Electric 75-60
title.zh: 电动低压60带有标注 Electric 75-60

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric Low Pressure 60 as 75 kW, also labelled Electric 75-60, at 35 m³/h. Electric 60 is the 90 kW page at 40 m³/h.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动低压60印成 75 kW，并标注 Electric 75-60，输送量 35 m³/h。电动60是 90 kW、40 m³/h 那一页。

h1.en: Order the 75 kW Label, Not the Numeral 60
h1.zh: 按 75 kW 的标注下单，不要按数字 60

directAnswer.en: On the Electric Low Pressure 60 page, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the model as Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60, motor 75 kW, theoretical output 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, hopper 0.5 m³, fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 100 m / 300 m and 24 mm stone 80 m / 240 m. The frame is 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg. Electric 60 prints 90 kW, 40 m³/h and hopper 0.7 m³ on a 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm frame. Put Electric 75-60 or the low-pressure path in the inquiry so the 75 kW cell is the one quoted. No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 在电动低压60页上，河北品锦机械（邢台）把型号印成电动低压60 / Electric 75-60，电机 75 kW，理论输送量 35 m³/h，30 MPa，料斗 0.5 m³，细石 150 m / 350 m，13 mm 石子 100 m / 300 m，24 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m。外形 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm，重量 3500 kg。电动60印 90 kW、40 m³/h、料斗 0.7 m³，外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm。询盘里写 Electric 75-60 或低压路径，这样报价对着的才是 75 kW。没有印价格。

body.en: Name fine stone, 13 mm or 24 mm. The pairs are not interchangeable inside one sentence.
body.zh: 点明细石、13 mm 或 24 mm。这些组不能在一句话里互换。

body.en: Diesel 60 is 144 kW diesel and 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm. Same kilograms, different path.
body.zh: 柴油60是 144 kW 柴油机，外形 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm。公斤数相同，路径不同。

answer.en: No. Electric 60 is 90 kW and 40 m³/h.

question.en: What does 75-60 mean on the sheet?

answer.en: It is the printed label beside 75 kW on this low-pressure page.
answer.zh: 它是这一低压页上、75 kW 旁边的印刷标注。

question.en: Is the price on the label?
